summary: Iran launched a missile toward the Strait of Hormuz, while Israeli forces destroyed illegal outposts in the West Bank. The UAE released $2.12 billion in Iranian assets, including 1.5 tons of gold, amid escalating regional tensions. Hezbollah disarmament negotiations involving European nations are underway.
key_points: IRGC launched a missile from Sirrik toward the Strait of Hormuz at 21:55 local time (Source: @shin_persian/8950).
Israeli forces destroyed two illegal outposts in the West Bank near Kurtz and Ja'luud (Source: @New_security8200/203288).
UAE released $2.12 billion in Iranian assets, including 1.5 tons of gold, via Boeing 737-7KK BBJ A6-RJA (Source: @kianmeli1/90837).
Israel and Lebanon agreed to European-led Hezbollah disarmament mechanism (Source: @yediotnews25/133876).
Israeli strike in northern Gaza's Beit Lahiya killed one person and injured another (Source: @manniefabian/58955).
Former IRGC commander stated Trump ordered three targets: Iranian ships in Gulf, Soleimani's killing, and attacks on Quds Force bases (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79193).
Indian refusal to send Iranian medical supplies due to Strait of Hormuz blockade (Source: @VahidOnline/77835).
Israeli defense minister confirmed no withdrawal from security zones and continued destruction of Iranian-funded terror infrastructure (Source: @amitsegal/63838).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's missile launch toward the Strait of Hormuz signals direct escalation, potentially targeting US naval assets. Israeli operations in the West Bank and Gaza indicate sustained pressure on Iranian-backed infrastructure. Hezbollah disarmament negotiations suggest regional efforts to de-escalate, but UAE's release of Iranian assets may embolden Iranian financial resilience. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint amid US-Iran tensions.
sections.regional_response: European nations (UK, Italy, Switzerland, Indonesia) are positioned to oversee Hezbollah disarmament, reflecting international mediation efforts. India's refusal to send medical supplies to Iran highlights the Strait of Hormuz blockade's humanitarian impact. UAE's release of Iranian assets demonstrates Gulf state balancing between US pressure and Iranian economic interests. Israeli operations in the West Bank and Gaza underscore ongoing security challenges.
sections.intelligence_notes: IRGC missile launch from Sirrik toward the Strait of Hormuz indicates operational readiness and potential targeting of US naval assets. UAE's release of $2.12 billion in Iranian assets, including gold, suggests financial decoupling from US sanctions. Israeli military operations in the West Bank and Gaza reflect sustained pressure on Iranian-backed infrastructure. Hezbollah disarmament negotiations involve European monitoring, indicating regional diplomatic engagement.
